source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: (electricity OR "energy access") AND (slum OR "informal settlement" OR urban poor)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:(electricity OR "energy access") AND (slum OR "informal settlement" OR urban poor),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("energy access" OR "electricity") AND ("informal settlement" OR "slum" OR ("poor" AND "urban")))
